carousels.name: 1 in 13 young adults screened positive for p*rn addiction

slides.title: About [[1 in 13]] young adults screened positive for p*rn addiction.
slides.sub: And one of the biggest links was sleep.

slides.title: Had watched [[p*rn]]
slides.body: In a study of 1,008 young adults in Rhode Island (2024 data, published 2025), 56.7% had viewed p*rn.

slides.title: Screened [[positive]]
slides.body: 7.9% screened positive for p*rn addiction on a standard scale — roughly 1 in 13 young adults.

slides.title: The [[sleep]] link
slides.body: Insomnia was linked to higher odds of p*rn addiction — mainly among heterosexual men. It's a link, not proof — but bad nights and p*rn often travel together.

slides.title: What to do [[with this]]
items: If you're the 1 in 13 — you're not alone.
Protect your sleep — it protects you from p*rn.
Ask for help early, not years later.
slides.note: Send this to a friend. Statistically, someone in your group chat is the 1 in 13 ↗

slides.title: P*rn is not "self-care." [[It's self-sabotage with good marketing.]]
slides.sub: "I deserve it" is the lie that keeps you stuck.

slides.title: Self-care makes you [[better]]
slides.body: Sleep, food, rest, people — you feel better after. After p*rn, most people feel worse, emptier and more tired.

slides.title: "I [[deserve]] it."
slides.body: You deserve rest. You deserve relief. You deserve pleasure. P*rn gives you none of those for long.

slides.title: Call it what it [[is]]
slides.body: Avoiding stress. Numbing loneliness. Killing time. Name what p*rn is really doing for you — honestly.

slides.title: The [[fight]]
slides.body: Urges, restlessness, doubt. Learning your triggers. It's the hardest month — and the most important.

slides.title: The [[shift]]
slides.body: Many describe p*rn urges getting weaker and less frequent. You start to trust yourself again.

slides.title: The [[new normal]]
slides.body: Your routines feel natural. P*rn isn't your default anymore. Slips can still happen — but you bounce back faster.

slides.title: The [[proof]]
slides.body: A whole year without p*rn. Many describe more confidence, deeper relationships and a clearer head. Everyone's path differs — but the direction is worth it.
